summary: Executor wake rule: dispatch clears an idle executor that is not claiming queued eligible work, and restarts an executor whose roster state is unknown once per stall, without a per-incident ruling

options.description: dispatch clears idle non-claiming executors and restarts unknown ones once per stall, reporting a repeat
every restart needs a fresh planner ruling (status quo)

body: Drain stalls (2026-10-21: 11 queued, 0 inflight, beta idle, alpha and gamma unknown) because executor loops stop between tasks and dispatch treats restart as outside its operational list without a recorded ruling. Class (a): a clear or restart is reversible, touches one executor session, and changes no trust-chain or governance control. Delta/epsilon stay idle under the three-executor rule until the hierarchy runs on the RFC-0054 webhook. A second non-claim after one restart is reported to the planner with the command output, not retried.
